Worked example 15.7: Measuring a reflex angle

Use a protractor and measure the angle shown below.

  1. Step 1: Consider the diagram and estimate the size of the angle.

    The diagram shows two arms: and . They form a reflex angle, which is shaded red.

    A reflex angle is between and . This angle is very near to .

  2. Step 2: Find a way to measure this reflex angle.

    An ordinary protractor can only measure angles between to . We cannot measure a reflex angle with an ordinary protractor. We have to measure the angle that is not shaded and then subtract the answer from .

  3. Step 3: Place the protractor correctly on the angle to measure.

    • The centre of the protractor should be on the vertex of the angle.
    • The base line of the protractor should be on one arm of the angle.

  4. Step 4: Choose the scale and read off the size of the angle.

    The acute angle measures .

  5. Step 5: Subtract the measured angle from and give the correct answer. Check against your estimation, and name the reflex angle correctly.

    \begin {align} \text{Reflex } Z\hat{X}Y &= 360^{\circ} - 18^{\circ}\\ &= 342^{\circ} \end {align}

records.answer_text:
Step 1: Consider the diagram and estimate the size of the angle.

The diagram shows two arms: $XY$ and $XZ$. They form a reflex angle, which is shaded red.

A reflex angle is between $180^{\circ}$ and $360^{\circ}$. This angle is very near to $360^{\circ}$.

Step 2: Find a way to measure this reflex angle.

An ordinary protractor can only measure angles between $0^{\circ}$ to $180^{\circ}$. We cannot measure a reflex angle with an ordinary protractor. We have to measure the angle that is not shaded and then subtract the answer from $360^{\circ}$.

Step 3: Place the protractor correctly on the angle to measure.

[Protractor placement image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/ebw-jss1-15-017.png]

- The centre of the protractor should be on the vertex of the angle.
- The base line of the protractor should be on one arm of the angle.

Step 4: Choose the scale and read off the size of the angle.

The acute angle measures $18^{\circ}$.

Step 5: Subtract the measured angle from $360^{\circ}$ and give the correct answer. Check against your estimation, and name the reflex angle correctly.

Reflex $Z\hat{X}Y = 360^{\circ} - 18^{\circ} = 342^{\circ}$.

records.content_text:
A straight line is also called a straight angle. A straight angle is equal to $180^{\circ}$. If a straight line is formed by more than one angle, the sum of those angles will be $180^{\circ}$. We say the angles are **supplementary angles**.

In the first diagram, the two angles are supplementary angles, because they form a straight line:

$$
\hat{P}_1 + \hat{P}_2 = 180^{\circ}
$$

[Source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/ebw-jss1-15-024.png]

We can also say that the two angles in the diagram above are **adjacent angles**. Adjacent angles are next to each other. Two adjacent angles share the same vertex and they also share one common arm.

In the second diagram below, $\hat{M}_1$ and $\hat{M}_2$ have the same vertex, but they do not share a common arm.

[Source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/ebw-jss1-15-025.png]

$\hat{M}_1$ and $\hat{M}_2$ are not adjacent angles, because they do not share a common arm.
